title: Full perimeter trim: the trimmed interior, where the robot stands, is cut free of the towers' frame
rationale: A perimeter trim 60 to 320 mm in from the edges, cut through except a 30 mm bridge, which this program closes. The tower anchors a1 and a2 (safety-model 5.3) stay on the outer frame, so the trimmed interior, larger than the frame, is the detached part and every wheel on it is M-ATTACH (the case also catches a checker that takes the largest piece for the anchor). The literal 10 mm trim of the design's case list is RT04b.
